Author: IndividualGather
Name: XIV MCP
Punchline: Let AI assistants read your live character data via the Model Context Protocol.
Description:
Runs a local MCP server (Streamable HTTP, localhost only) that exposes live data of your logged-in character: stats, jobs, inventory, gear, currencies, quests, achievements, unlocks (mounts, minions, orchestrion, cards, ...), party, nearby objects, FATEs, retainers and the full game data sheets.

Connect any MCP client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, ...) to http://localhost:<port>/mcp with the bearer token shown in the settings window.
